title: Sales by Day of Week
prompt: Report units sold per item category by weekday. Return item_category, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
expected_query: SELECT i.item_category, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM CAST(o.order_date AS DATE)) = 1 THEN o.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS Monday, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM CAST(o.order_date AS DATE)) = 2 THEN o.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS Tuesday, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM CAST(o.order_date AS DATE)) = 3 THEN o.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS Wednesday, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM CAST(o.order_date AS DATE)) = 4 THEN o.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS Thursday, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM CAST(o.order_date AS DATE)) = 5 THEN o.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS Friday, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM CAST(o.order_date AS DATE)) = 6 THEN o.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS Saturday, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM CAST(o.order_date AS DATE)) = 0 THEN o.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS Sunday FROM orders o INNER JOIN items i ON o.item_id = i.item_id GROUP BY i.item_category;
explanation: Join orders to item categories, group by category, and use one SUM(CASE WHEN ...) expression per weekday.
hints: DOW 0 is Sunday and DOW 1 is Monday in DuckDB.
Use a separate conditional SUM for each weekday.
common_mistakes: Grouping by date instead of category.
